ChatThread.description: Native Compose chat thread reimplementation based on the UIArc ChatThread interaction model.

props.voiceNote: boolean; renders the native Bencho VoiceNote interaction in the composer
props.botAvatarFallback: missing participant.avatar URLs fall back to native BotAvatar using deterministic type/seed/state

ReorderList.description: Native Compose port of Bencho ReorderList / Arrange liquid reorder interaction.

IconBar.description: Native Compose floating navigation bar port of Bencho IconBar with elastic two-phase selection indicator.

props.items: data path to array of {key,label,icon}; icon uses local Hugeicons resources
props.dilate: integer 0..100; how much the indicator spans the union while moving
props.bounce: integer 0..100; elastic overshoot strength, 50 is the tuned value
props.speed: integer 0..100; animation speed, 50 is the tuned value
props.corner: dp corner radius; capped at 26 by the original geometry
